page.overview:
What is Battle of Boz Pity?

The Battle of Boz Pity was a battle fought during the Imperial Era. Following the rescue of Rebel Alliance Admiral Gial Ackbar en route to Kessel, Ackbar was injured during the Battle of Boz Pity, but recovered after bacta treatment.
